terms.definition: A stored, named, tested link from the platform to an external data store (database, object store). Holds coordinates and a secret reference, never data and never the secret value.

A tenant/workspace-authorized credential name, resolved only inside an executor adapter. Console accepts approved aws-sm/vault adapters; env/file are restricted to operator-run local CLI. Secret values never enter model inputs or artifacts.

Stored data owned or referenced independently of publication. File/table imports produce a dataset; service-source imports may additionally mirror the source service and layers under an explicit mirror_service policy.
A remote ArcGIS/GeoServices FeatureServer or MapServer layer, copied into the platform by an import job (owned copy).
A table or view in a PostGIS database reached through a connection and published in place (no copy). Validated before publish.
An uploaded file (GeoJSON, Shapefile, GeoPackage, CSV and others the platform lists) imported into an owned table via an upload and a background import job.

One protocol surface over a dataset (GeoServices FeatureServer, OGC API Features, WMS, WFS, WMTS, STAC, vector tiles, ...). One dataset can have many services. A service has one or more layers; the default is one layer named after the dataset. Publishing never imports.
A named feature or raster collection inside a service. Default: one layer named after the dataset.
A renderer/symbology definition bound to a layer, stored in a portable form (honua style JSON, optionally SLD/OGC Styles). Presets and auto-suggestions are ways to produce one.
A map composition with working drafts and explicit saved versions. Draft edits do not save or publish a version.
The umbrella for authored, versioned, publishable content items: a map or a dashboard (and other package families). Journey stage 6 calls them 'durable compositions'.
A dashboard composition of widgets bound to maps/layers. Package-family IDs and schema versions require runtime discovery.
A bounded, durable, cancellable execution of a geoprocessing operation (e.g. geometry.buffer) on the job runtime, identified by jobId and read back by it. Not an operation-gateway call.
Governed publication of an exact saved item/version/hash, proposed by an applying human and approved separately by another authorized human. Service publication remains a distinct operation.
A durable record of a requested governed operation in state AwaitingApproval, bound to the exact item/version/hash, with proposalId.
The decision by a principal different from the proposer, with admin:approve, that allows a proposal to execute (or rejects it).
An authenticated human or agent identity established by the server. A spec as field never switches credentials or grants authority.
A running Honua installation: server, its database, cache and workers, on a deployment target. The thing every other node is applied to.
Platform on the local Docker engine via the owned compose fixture (server, PostGIS, Redis).
Platform on AWS ECS behind an ALB with RDS; multiple tasks.
Platform on AWS Lambda (serverless, API function from a mirrored ECR image) with RDS.
A canonical spec document: grammarVersion, processFamilyVersion, nodes[]. Validated, planned into a content-hashed DAG, applied with streamed events.
An entry in the platform capability registry, keyed honua://capability/<key>, with edition and lifecycle status. The join between vocabulary, docs, licensing and routes.
`workers` attribute of a platform: a worker pool for gp or import work (e.g. backed by AWS Batch). Not a target.
Platform on AWS EKS installed from the Helm chart.
A reference to a service layer inside a working map draft.
